note: The real tool-output capture corpus, one file because a Claude Skill package may hold at most 200 files and may not contain a nested zip. `b64` is the base64 of the EXACT bytes the tool produced — BOMs, CRLFs and UTF-16LE payloads intact — and `sha256` is the digest of the decoded bytes, verified on every read. Regenerate with `python -m shipgate.authority.capturestore --pack DIR`; read with `--extract DIR`; check with `--verify`.
